theorem mvcc.twWrap_metrics (mw : Loc) : ⊢ mvcc.twWrap
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.metricsTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal mw) mw

def mvcc.twMethod (M : GoString) : Prop :=
  M = go!"Range" ∨
    M = go!"Put" ∨
      M = go!"DeleteRange" ∨
        M = go!"Rev" ∨
          M = go!"FirstRev" ∨ M = go!"Changes"

    a)) {{ Φ }} ⊢ WP ((intoVal (methods tyX M vX)) (intoVal a)) {{ Φ }}

def mvcc.twWrap (tyX : go.GoType) (vX : val) (mw : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜tyX = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.metricsTxnWrite.ty.PointerType ∧ vX = intoVal mw⌝ ∨
      ∃ twl ws,
        ⌜tyX = go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watchableStoreTxnWrite.ty.PointerType ∧ vX = intoVal twl⌝ ∗
          typedPointsto twl
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.metricsTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal mw),
              s' := ws }
            DFrac.discard)
